summary.name: Tech Culture Archives (The New Stack)
summary.one_liner: A category archive page from The New Stack collecting articles on software engineering team culture, DevOps culture, and institutional bias in tech.
use_cases: Reading about building culture in a software engineering team
Learning why DevOps culture improves collaboration and recovery
Finding articles on inclusivity and institutional bias in tech
Researching how culture affects cloud-native and DevOps practices
summary.what_it_does: This is an archive page of articles from The New Stack on tech culture, covering how organizational culture shapes software engineering teams. It includes a short guide with five steps for building a software company culture: growing the current culture, communicating value, promoting positivity, creating SMART goals, and paying attention to health. It also summarizes benefits of DevOps culture, such as increased efficiency, job satisfaction, collaboration, and easier recovery from failed deployments, and discusses institutional bias and open-source culture. The page itself is an index of commentary rather than a software tool.
notable: Collects New Stack coverage on DevOps, cloud-native, and engineering culture
Includes a five-step guide to building a software company culture
Covers DevOps benefits such as trunk-based development and test automation for faster recovery
caveats: Page is a category archive of articles, not a tool or product
Page text does not describe the on-call systems article listed in awesome-sre
